# BroService

> BroService provides home, property and everyday support services on Koh Phangan, Surat Thani, Thailand. The website presents services for residents, villa owners, tenants and visitors. Contact the team to confirm availability, scope and pricing for a specific job.

Website: https://broservice.in.th/
Primary location: Koh Phangan, Surat Thani, Thailand
Service area: Koh Phangan, including Thong Sala, Srithanu, Haad Rin, Baan Tai and Chaloklum
Languages shown on the website: English, Russian, Thai and Hebrew
